crossRefs.note: “If I testify about myself, my witness is not valid.

translations.web: The Pharisees therefore said to him, “You testify about yourself. Your testimony is not valid.”
translations.bsb: So the Pharisees said to Him, “You are testifying about Yourself; Your testimony is not valid.”
translations.kjv: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.
translations.asv: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest witness of thyself; thy witness is not true.
